findings.summary: Old summary API (formatSummary/writeSummary) coexists with unified-summary — only tests use old path
evidence: formatSummary, writeSummary, SummaryData, MergeOutcome, FileChanges, RepoResult are exported from github-summary.ts and re-exported through output/index.ts, but no production code imports them — only test/unit/github-summary.test.ts and test/unit/index.test.ts
buildRepoResult, toFileChanges, getMergeOutcome from summary-utils.ts are similarly test-only — no imports from src/cli/ or any production path
Production code uses writeUnifiedSummary from unified-summary.ts (imported in src/cli/sync-command.ts:91)
writeGitHubStepSummary (the low-level file writer) IS actively used in production by unified-summary.ts, sync-report.ts, settings-report.ts, and lifecycle-report.ts
findings.suggestion: Assess whether the old summary test coverage is still needed. If the test scenarios are covered by unified-summary tests, remove formatSummary, writeSummary, shouldWriteSummary and the SummaryData/RepoResult/FileChanges types from github-summary.ts, remove buildRepoResult/toFileChanges/getMergeOutcome/buildErrorResult from summary-utils.ts, and update output/index.ts to stop re-exporting them. Keep writeGitHubStepSummary and MergeOutcome (if used elsewhere). This removes ~200 lines of dead production code and their test-only consumers.
